senses.gloss: श्लोकवार्तिक Varttika or supplemen- tary rule to Panini's rules laid down by scholars of grammar immediately after Pahini, com- posed in verse form. These Slokavarttikas are quoted in the Mahabhasya at various places and supposed to have been current in the explanations of Panini's Asta- dhyayi in the days of Patanjali. The word is often used by later commentators.
